plugins.name: cachewraith-skills
plugins.description: Nine engineering skills for Claude Code: an OWASP Top Ten security audit that names the category ID for every finding, a performance audit that reports evidence rather than vibes, a test skill that finds and uses the project's own runner, a branch-and-commit helper with a fixed naming convention, an API documentation generator that investigates real endpoints and publishes frontend-ready docs as an Artifact, and a release helper that bumps the version everywhere it lives in any ecosystem, then tags and pushes it, and a Spring Boot structure skill that scaffolds a versioned module-per-feature package tree and records the layout in CLAUDE.md, and an OWASP skill that installs the Top Ten as a standing instruction in a project, and a design-pattern skill that makes pattern choice a deliberate, stated step.
